title: Cross-run report discovery keys on tick_id, which two repositories sharing an ExecStateRoot can collide on
description:
Report discovery matches a previous attempt by the tick_id on its attempt record. Within one tracker that is exact - tick ids are unique per tracker - but a host running epics of TWO repositories against one ExecStateRoot could be offered the other repository's reports whenever the tick ids collide.

Nothing durable on the attempt record distinguishes them: repo is a host path (different in every clone), repo_key hashes that host path, and job_id names only the run and the tick. A durable remote or tracker identity on the record would close it.

Filed rather than fixed because it is latent: it needs two repositories, one shared ExecStateRoot and a tick id collision. Worth doing before ticfac is pointed at more than one repository on a host - which Phase 4's cloud host makes likelier, not less.

discovered_from run-epic-9pd/tick-n4h/attempt-32
acceptance_criteria: An attempt record carries an identity that distinguishes its tracker across clones, and cross-run discovery uses it alongside the tick id. A test covers two repositories sharing one ExecStateRoot with the same tick id, and proves neither is offered the other's reports.
